description: Per-pressure-channel timing decisions for the local-P check. Decisions use timing evidence only (never gains). Channels not listed use timing mode 'none' (zero lag, independent pressure/vertical onset check).

drift.source: scripts/fit_local_p_clock_drift.py on campaign all_v1 XO.LT02..HDH events.csv (sha256 c58ba5df7c21f292a6a513005897deb33f4de9b41767aff9952da02352d2253e): 16 inliers, residual RMS 0.090 s, max 0.207 s, one 1.05 s outlier excluded

XO.LT02..HDH.evidence: Separate LDEO APG logger. Per-event refined lags fall on a line (-5.6 ppm, about -107 s by 30 Dec 2018); the line predicts Deng et al. (2022) teleseismic offsets of 93.04-102.69 s within 0.3 s.

XO.LA33..HDH.evidence: Wide-window plots of five M5.0-6.0 events (July-Dec 2018) show HDH and HHZ arrivals coincident within about a second; 2-10 Hz cross-correlation lags -0.02 to 0.00 s for all five. No drift like LT02. The lag search failed only because APG onset SNR in 2-10 Hz is low.

XO.LA34..HDH.evidence: Wide-window plots of five M5.0-6.0 events show coincident arrivals within about a second; 0.5-2 Hz cross-correlation lags 0.00, -0.04, -0.06 s for the three highest-SNR events. 2-10 Hz APG SNR is too low for a sub-second check, which the per-event onset test still applies.
